lines.zh: 我沿墙爬，指甲抠着砖缝。
lines.en: I crawl the wall, nails dug into the seams.
Most of my skin has been stripped.

lines.zh: 露出来的地方是灰白的。
lines.en: What shows is gray and pale.

lines.zh: 我走一步，肩胛就动一下。
lines.en: Each step works my shoulder blade.
I head down the corridor.

lines.zh: 我的手指很长，垂在膝边。
lines.en: My long fingers hang by my knees.
I stop and tilt my head.
I smell bone.
I keep to the shadows.
I pass a shut door.

lines.zh: 路过一道紧闭的门，我绕了过去。
lines.en: I pass a shut door and go around it.

lines.zh: 我顺着墙影，一路摸过去。
lines.en: I keep to the wall's shade and move on.
I stand, my skin hanging loose.

lines.zh: 我垂着皮站着，我不眨眼。
lines.en: Standing with my skin hanging, I don't blink.

lines.zh: 垂下来的皮下面，我没有脸。
lines.en: Beneath the hanging skin, I have no face.
No face, but plenty of teeth.
They're more eager to move than I am.

lines.zh: 我活动手指，等它们听话。
lines.en: I work my fingers until they obey.
I hear something in the wall.
I keep these hands.

lines.zh: 我留这双手，它们还有用。
lines.en: I keep these hands. They're still useful.

lines.zh: 墙那边的脚步，一声一声。
lines.en: Footsteps on the far side, one by one.
I raise my head, teeth toward you.
I bare my teeth. You don't step back.
You don't retreat. That's rare.
I'm looking at your skin.

lines.zh: 我在看你的皮，它很完整。
lines.en: I'm looking at your skin. It's quite intact.

lines.zh: 我举起手来，停一停又收回去。
lines.en: I raise a hand, pause, and withdraw it.
I note the ground you stand on.
I’ve fixed your position.

lines.zh: 眼下还不到下手的时候，我退开。
lines.en: Not the moment yet. I walk away.
I drop my hand back to my side.
Another patch of skin splits.

lines.zh: 又有一片皮翻落，露出骨。
lines.en: Another patch peels, baring bone.

lines.zh: 骨头露在外面，我倒退半步。
lines.en: Bone showing, I step back.

lines.zh: 我侧着头瞧你，一声也不出。
lines.en: I look at you sidelong, silent.

lines.zh: 我侧着脑袋，慢慢打量你。
lines.en: I tilt my head and consider you.
That struck bone.

lines.zh: 我直起腰，骨头咔嚓一响。
lines.en: I straighten up; bones crack.

lines.zh: 伤口张开，底下什么也没有。
lines.en: The wound opens; there is nothing beneath.

lines.zh: 血早已流干，四肢照样能动。
lines.en: No blood left, and the limbs still work.
I pull my hand back to my chest.

lines.zh: 你手里那个，我不吃这个。
lines.en: That thing in your hand. I don't eat it.
It's not flesh I want.
It's the layer outside.

lines.zh: 我盯上的是你那层皮，你退了。
lines.en: It's your skin I want. You stepped back.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就少等一刻。
lines.en: One step back, and I wait a little less.
I raise a hand and measure.
I raise a hand and measure. Just right.
You'll tire eventually. I can wait.

lines.zh: 我不怕耗，你迟早撑不住。
lines.en: I can outlast you. You'll falter.
And then I'll start.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我抓住了你的袖子。
lines.en: You bump me and I catch your sleeve.

lines.zh: 抓着你的袖子，我松开了。
lines.en: I had your sleeve. I let go.
My nails leave a few lines.
I look down at the marks.
The lines my nails left are very shallow.

lines.zh: 我看过那几道浅痕，就退开了。
lines.en: I look at the shallow lines and step away.
I've let go. Not yet.
I walk on. You stay where you are.
I watch you a long while.
I circle half round and press back to the wall.
Flayers aren't born.

lines.zh: 是同化人类杀够骷髅之后变的。
lines.en: They're what an assimilated human becomes after enough skeletons.

lines.zh: 还没变样时，我宰过五个。
lines.en: Before this shape, I killed five.
Then I became this.

lines.zh: 我不记得第五个是什么样子。
lines.en: I don't remember what the fifth looked like.

lines.zh: 不记得样子，我记得声音。
lines.en: Not the look. I remember the sound.
A finger twitches.
Who's next.
I spread my fingers and close them.
Among flayers, only who goes first.
Neither side of this looks like skin.
Turned over, it's a patch of skin.
I press it against myself.

lines.zh: 按在自己身上，半点粘不住。
lines.en: Pressed to myself, it won't stick.
The second try, it slips off again.

lines.zh: 第二回贴上去，仍旧滑落。
lines.en: A second try, and it slides off again.
I put it away.
Maybe it'll be useful.
A shadow moves on the wall.
I hang it on myself.

lines.zh: 我伏在墙面，你才转过来。
lines.en: I cling to the wall as you turn.

lines.zh: 我挂在门框上头，等你进门。
lines.en: I hang above the doorframe, waiting for you to enter.
I'm on the ceiling.

lines.zh: 我倒挂在顶上，你终于抬头。
lines.en: I hang from the ceiling. You finally look up.
You looked up. Too late.
Too late. I let go.

lines.zh: 下落的时候，骨头在蓄力。
lines.en: As I drop, my bones load up.

lines.zh: 手指一松，我就坠了下去。
lines.en: My fingers open and I drop.
My nails catch.
I'm on the floor, limbs spread.
On all fours, then I stand.

lines.zh: 我从墙上一寸寸滑下来。
lines.en: I slide down the wall an inch at a time.

lines.zh: 起身费劲，落脚却一点不虚。
lines.en: Slow to rise, but every step is sure.
I'm coming again.
I press even closer to the floor.
You run to the end of the corridor.

lines.zh: 你奔到廊子尽头，我紧随其后。
lines.en: You reach the corridor's end. I'm right after.
My knees bend backwards.
So I'm faster.

lines.zh: 我膝头朝后反折，你回了头。
lines.en: My knee bends backwards. You look back.

lines.zh: 你一回头，我已经贴在墙上。
lines.en: You look back. I'm already on the wall.
You turn and run for the door.
You run for the door. It's locked.
Locked. You turn.
You turn. I'm right by the door.
My fingers spread one by one.

lines.zh: 五指张开，你把家伙举了起来。
lines.en: My fingers spread. You raise your weapon.
You raise a weapon. I don't dodge.
Pain stopped scaring me long ago.
I only want the skin.
I only want the skin. Give it to me.
It's still good. It'll be quick.
I press my fingers to the wall.
My nails rake across your collarbone.

lines.zh: 指爪一拉，那层皮翻开了。
lines.en: One drag of my nails and the skin opens.

lines.zh: 我扣住你的手指，一根根掰。
lines.en: I grip your fingers and bend them back one by one.
Bone shifts under my palm.

lines.zh: 我扣住你的腕子，你喊了出来。
lines.en: I clamp your wrist. You cry out.

lines.zh: 掌下骨节作响，我不停手。
lines.en: Bone shifts under my palm. I keep on.
You kick my chest.

lines.zh: 你一脚踹中胸口，我倒退开。
lines.en: Your boot finds my chest. I fall back.

lines.zh: 我从地上撑起，关节反折。
lines.en: I push up from the floor, joints bending backward.
My chest is dented.

lines.zh: 胸口塌下去一块，我毫不在意。
lines.en: My chest is caved in. I don't care.
This time I go for the throat.

lines.zh: 这一下要抓脖子，你退到墙边。
lines.en: This time the throat. You're against the wall.

lines.zh: 你靠到墙根去了，正合适。
lines.en: Backed to the wall. Perfect.
You're against the wall. Don't move.
I hold my hand up before you.
I hang down from the roof.
Four limbs brace the wall.

lines.zh: 我垂在屋檐下，皮在风里晃。
lines.en: I hang from the eaves. My skin sways.

lines.zh: 我从屋顶垂下来，没有脸。
lines.en: Hanging from the roof, I have no face.

lines.zh: 垂下来的皮下面，只有牙。
lines.en: Beneath the hanging skin, only teeth.
I hear a sound downstairs.
I turn my head that way to listen.

lines.zh: 楼下有人声，话还没说完。
lines.en: Voices below. Still talking.
I crawl down the wall.
My nails sink into the mortar.

lines.zh: 顺着墙爬下去，我在它身后。
lines.en: I crawl down the wall. I'm behind it.

lines.zh: 指甲抠进砖缝，它始终没回头。
lines.en: My nails bite the mortar. It never turns.

lines.zh: 摸到它背后，我把手摊开。
lines.en: Behind it, I open my hands.
I'll let it finish. Just once.
My skin curls and I shake it.
On landing my bones come apart.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我抓不住东西。
lines.en: Water floods in and I can't grip anything.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我撞在天花板上。
lines.en: The blast slams me into the ceiling.
A round passes through, leaving a hole.
Light pins me to the wall.
I'm so empty even my bones feel light.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的手指全僵了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my fingers lock.
I fall, limbs still crawling.
